data.name: Balbeer
data.gender_notes: Balbeer is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Balbeer is a compound name derived from Sanskrit. 'Bal' means strength and 'Beer' means fearless or brave. In Hindu mythology, Balbeer is a name associated with the god Hanuman, who embodies strength, courage, and devotion. The name Balbeer carries the meaning “Brave and Strong” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Balbeer usually hope their child will grow to embody brave and strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of inner strength and fearlessness, inspiring courage and determination.
data.etymology: Balbeer belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave and Strong.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Balbeer total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
